ai_summary: AAKASH EXPLORATION SERVICES LIMITED reported a substantial quarter-on-quarter decline in Q1 FY27, with net profit dropping over 72% and total revenue falling by 11.6%, despite a 21.6% year-on-year revenue increase, signaling significant margin compression and a material impact on profitability. Key governance updates include the appointment of Mr. Vihan Vipul Haria, a promoter group member and relative of the Managing Director, as a Whole Time Director, which could raise red flags regarding independent oversight. Concurrently, a promoter entity with nil shareholding is seeking reclassification to the public category.
